$comment: The processes Dyno may start, for scripts/vm-smoke (docs: scripts/vm-smoke/README.md). Each process is Contents/MacOS/<name> of the installed bundle. parents: who may be its parent (app = the app process; launchd = parent pid 1, allowed only while Launch at login is on). argsPattern keeps the CLI calls of the check itself (dyno-agent status) out of the count. stateFiles name the discovery file the app finds its helper by: the pid in it must be the one live helper, and it is gone after Quit unless Start at login is on (launchd then keeps the agent, and its file, alive). loginJob: the SMAppService job whose agent shows in ps as a bare `dyno-agent run`; it is identified by `launchctl print` (the pid), and it is expected to survive Quit while the login service is on. ready: a command that exits 0 once the helper answers.

loginService.label: net.decryptology.dyno.agent
loginService.manualReason: the app registers its login item with SMAppService, which only the app itself calls; `dyno-agent service install` writes a legacy LaunchAgents plist and bootstraps it with launchctl, a different route that is not what users run. The guest does have an Aqua session, but driving the Settings toggle needs a UI driver (see the GUI VM research), which this check does not have
loginService.approval: System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions may ask to allow the item (manual).

settleWhy: The supervisor has no fixed spawn wait any more (SPAWN_WAIT and CONNECT_GRACE are gone). The longest respawn timer is the crash-loop backoff capped at 15 s, plus 3 s END_GRACE before the held child is ended on a Retry or hand-over, plus the 2 s polling: 20 s covers one full respawn cycle. A second agent after that is a bug, not a timer.
